card.name: Second digit of reference numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts a two-digit number, where the number's first digit was just read. This is mostly the tens digit of a reference citation or list item number, such as 62, 23, 46 or 37.

modes.label: Citation numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a two-digit superscript or bracketed reference number after a statement.

modes.label: Numbered list items
modes.description: The tens digit of a numbered step, claim or rule in a list.
